sentences.pt: Felipe é brasileiro e estuda numa universidade em Boston.
sentences.en: Felipe is Brazilian and studies at a university in Boston.

sentences.pt: Ele chegou aos Estados Unidos em janeiro, no meio do inverno.
sentences.en: He arrived in the United States in January, in the middle of winter.

sentences.pt: No começo, ele estava muito animado com a vida nova.
sentences.en: At first, he was very excited about his new life.

sentences.pt: Tudo era diferente e interessante.
sentences.en: Everything was different and interesting.

sentences.pt: Mas depois de dois meses, ele começou a sentir saudade do Brasil.
sentences.en: But after two months, he started to feel homesick for Brazil.

sentences.pt: Ele tinha saudade da família, dos amigos e da comida da mãe.
sentences.en: He missed his family, his friends and his mother's food.

sentences.pt: À noite, ele ficava sozinho no quarto e às vezes chorava.
sentences.en: At night, he stayed alone in his room and sometimes cried.

sentences.pt: Um dia, ele ligou para a mãe e contou tudo.
sentences.en: One day, he called his mother and told her everything.

sentences.pt: "Eu me sinto sozinho aqui, mãe", ele disse.
sentences.en: "I feel lonely here, Mom," he said.

sentences.pt: A mãe ficou preocupada, mas falou com calma.
sentences.en: His mother got worried, but spoke calmly.

sentences.pt: "Filho, isso é muito comum. Tente conhecer pessoas novas."
sentences.en: "Son, that's very common. Try to meet new people."

sentences.pt: Uma semana depois, Felipe decidiu ir a uma festa de estudantes.
sentences.en: A week later, Felipe decided to go to a student party.

sentences.pt: Lá, ele conheceu Sofia, uma estudante de Portugal.
sentences.en: There, he met Sofia, a student from Portugal.

sentences.pt: Os dois conversaram a noite toda em português.
sentences.en: The two of them talked all night in Portuguese.

sentences.pt: Sofia também sentia saudade de casa.
sentences.en: Sofia was also homesick.

sentences.pt: Agora eles cozinham pratos do Brasil e de Portugal aos domingos.
sentences.en: Now they cook dishes from Brazil and Portugal on Sundays.

sentences.pt: Felipe ainda tem saudade do Brasil de vez em quando.
sentences.en: Felipe still misses Brazil from time to time.

sentences.pt: Mas ele não se sente mais sozinho.
sentences.en: But he doesn't feel lonely anymore.

sentences.pt: "Na minha opinião, um bom amigo ajuda muito", ele escreveu para a mãe.
sentences.en: "In my opinion, a good friend helps a lot," he wrote to his mother.

sentences.pt: Eduardo estava desempregado desde março.
sentences.en: Eduardo had been unemployed since March.

sentences.pt: Na quarta-feira, ele tinha uma entrevista numa empresa grande.
sentences.en: On Wednesday, he had an interview at a big company.

sentences.pt: Na noite de terça-feira, ele não conseguiu dormir.
sentences.en: On Tuesday night, he couldn't sleep.

sentences.pt: Ele estava ansioso e com medo de falar algo errado.
sentences.en: He was anxious and afraid of saying something wrong.

sentences.pt: De manhã, ele usou a melhor camisa dele.
sentences.en: In the morning, he wore his best shirt.

sentences.pt: Mas no metrô, um homem empurrou o braço dele, e o café caiu na camisa.
sentences.en: But on the subway, a man pushed his arm, and the coffee fell on his shirt.

sentences.pt: Eduardo ficou irritado e envergonhado.
sentences.en: Eduardo got annoyed and embarrassed.

sentences.pt: "Que horrível! Agora vou chegar com a camisa suja", ele pensou.
sentences.en: "How awful! Now I'm going to arrive with a dirty shirt," he thought.

sentences.pt: Ele quase desistiu e voltou para casa.
sentences.en: He almost gave up and went back home.

sentences.pt: Mas ele respirou fundo e continuou.
sentences.en: But he took a deep breath and kept going.

sentences.pt: Na empresa, a chefe era muito simpática.
sentences.en: At the company, the boss was very friendly.

sentences.pt: Eduardo explicou o problema do café, um pouco envergonhado.
sentences.en: Eduardo explained the coffee problem, a little embarrassed.

sentences.pt: Ela riu e disse: "Não tem problema. Isso acontece com todo mundo."
sentences.en: She laughed and said: "No problem. That happens to everybody."

sentences.pt: Depois disso, Eduardo ficou mais calmo.
sentences.en: After that, Eduardo became calmer.

sentences.pt: Ele falou sobre a experiência dele e respondeu todas as perguntas.
sentences.en: He talked about his experience and answered all the questions.

sentences.pt: Dois dias depois, ele recebeu um e-mail da empresa.
sentences.en: Two days later, he got an email from the company.

sentences.pt: Ele leu a mensagem e não acreditou: eles queriam contratar Eduardo!
sentences.en: He read the message and couldn't believe it: they wanted to hire Eduardo!

sentences.pt: Ele ficou muito aliviado e feliz.
sentences.en: He was very relieved and happy.

sentences.pt: À noite, ele contou a notícia para a família.
sentences.en: In the evening, he told the family the news.

sentences.pt: "Estou muito orgulhosa de você", disse a mãe dele.
sentences.en: "I'm very proud of you," his mother said.

questions.qEn: How did Eduardo feel before the interview?
